source.title: Binance Web3 API — RWA Data
source.downloadableSchema: The page's schema download link was attempted but timed out; this record reflects the rendered official endpoint documentation, not a fetched OpenAPI document.

platforms.tickerCount: Number of underlying assets corresponding to RWA tokens.
platforms.chainDistributionTokenCount: Number of RWA tokens on the chain; the same underlying asset deployed on different chains is counted separately.
platforms.responseTimestamp: Server response time in Unix milliseconds.

filters.binanceChainId: Optional; omitted returns data from all chains.
filters.tabId: Optional sector filter; omitted returns all sectors; documented enum values are 1 through 13.

tokens.documentedResponseShape: A data array of RWA tokenized assets plus an envelope-level server timestamp.
tokens.paginationContract: The rendered endpoint documentation lists no page, pageSize, offset, cursor, limit, total-count, or continuation-token field. The downloadable schema was not retrieved, so absence from the rendered page is not proof that no undocumented runtime behavior exists.

search.requiredQuery: keyword (ticker, company name, or contract address)
search.results: Matched ticker rows containing tokenized assets across platforms and chains.
search.chainFilter: No chainId query parameter is listed in the rendered search endpoint documentation.

price.identity: binanceChainId plus comma-separated tokenContractAddresses; up to 100 addresses per request.
price.perAssetTimestamp: tokenPriceUpdatedAt is distinct from the envelope-level server timestamp.

comparisonWithPhase26Observation.declaredBscTokenCountBasis: Sum platform chainDistribution.tokenCount entries where binanceChainId is 56; this is not platform tickerCount.
comparisonWithPhase26Observation.returnedUniqueBscRepresentationsBasis: Count distinct normalized BSC identities (chainId plus lowercase token contract address) in the Phase 26 token-list rows.
comparisonWithPhase26Observation.sourceRecord: records/phase26-provider-observation.json; aggregate methods and values are retained, while raw rows and addresses are omitted, so independent recomputation requires a separately authorized observation.
comparisonWithPhase26Observation.interpretation: The two counts are conceptually comparable representation/token counts, not underlying-ticker counts. The official rendered documentation does not define pagination or a total-count contract for the token-list endpoint. Therefore pagination cannot be asserted as the cause; the observed difference remains unexplained and upstream completeness remains unverified.

implementationGapsConfirmedBySourceRevie: The token-list response contract distinguishes Stock, Pre-IPO, and ETF, while Ariadne's current listing model does not preserve assetType.
The token-list contract documents reasonCode, reasonMsg, and nextCloseTime, while Ariadne's current response/domain models do not preserve those details.
The existing normalized market-status mapping handles the six documented marketStatus values, but collapses distinct states into open, closed, or offhours.

sourceCodeCrosswalk.observedHandling: RwaSearchResponse declares assetType, but search() does not pass it to normalizeStockAsset; RwaTokenResponse and both downstream domain types do not declare assetType. The normalized search/list output therefore does not retain it.
sourceCodeCrosswalk.phase28Repair: Add a typed asset category and carry the documented values through list/search, SDK output and MCP/native research presentation without inventing unknown values.

sourceCodeCrosswalk.documentedField: statusInfo.marketStatus, openState, nextOpenTime, reasonCode, reasonMsg, nextCloseTime
sourceCodeCrosswalk.observedHandling: The response type and MarketContext retain openState and nextOpenTime only. reasonCode, reasonMsg and nextCloseTime are absent. normalizeMarketStatus() maps documented statuses to four broad internal values (open/closed/offhours/unknown), so the original detailed state is not available to consumers.
sourceCodeCrosswalk.phase28Repair: Preserve the documented raw status and optional reason/next-close context alongside the conservative normalized status; unknown enum values remain unknown and must not loosen transaction checks.

sourceCodeCrosswalk.documentedField: Token-list envelope timestamp; price endpoint tokenPriceUpdatedAt per representation
sourceCodeCrosswalk.observedHandling: The list endpoint envelope time and price endpoint per-asset time are represented separately. The rendered token-list contract does not promise tokenPriceUpdatedAt on each list item; Ariadne's optional list-item read is therefore not proof of a documented list guarantee. No missing timestamp is synthesized.
sourceCodeCrosswalk.phase28Repair: Keep endpoint provenance/timestamp semantics separate and do not promote the optional list-item field into a freshness guarantee.

test:jev-shadow (local Jev gate and approved-successor transition assertions)
phase27ExecutionBoundary.basis: Phase 27 work consisted of reading the rendered official documentation, local repository files, and running the listed local checks. The Jev evaluator used its separately configured reviewer authentication; no provider credential or authentication value was included in the evidence. This is a task execution record, not a claim derived from a new API response.

boundedConclusion: This is a documentation-to-code contract review only. No Binance endpoint was called, no catalog completeness was proved, and no provider behavior was inferred beyond the published field descriptions.
